title: Network Management: Main Exam, 22 August 2019
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE (COMPULSORY) AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain the value of carefully choosing a network topology.
Explain the meaning of the following in relation to networking.
Subnetting
Subnet mask
The two-level internet address structure specifies that IP addressing be done in two parts. Explain the parts.
Given the following IP address, 204.67.118.54, explain which class the IP address belongs to.
Outline any three (3) network management standards.
Identify and explain one primary function of the two sublayers of the OSI data link layer.
A network's topology affects its capabilities. Describe the hierarchical model and give four (4) advantages of implementing it.
You have an IP of 156.233.42.56 with a subnet mask of 7 bits. Determine the possible number of hosts and subnets. Show your workings.
Explain network management and highlight the typical activities involved.
In a given network, many devices share the same piece of network media, and devices vie for time on the cable through a process called media access. Discuss the three (3) media access methods.
Over the past few years, the internet has experienced two major scaling issues as it has struggled to provide continuous and uninterrupted growth. Outline these issues.
Explain the meaning of classful addressing in the context of IP addressing.
Network requirements translate into four (4) primary network design goals. Explain each.
According to the International Organization for Standardization, the network management process consists of five (5) main areas. Discuss each.
Explain any three (3) reasons that may compel a network engineer to opt for a wireless network implementation in place of a cabled network implementation.
Describe any four (4) network status monitoring tools.
Explain fault management in the context of networking and hence describe the steps involved in it.
Explain any four (4) reasons that may lead to subnetting or segmenting of a network.
Discuss any four (4) features of the TCP/IP protocol that make it the most suitable protocol for communication over the internet.
Describe any five (5) goals that you need to establish before undertaking a network design.
